subject: Quality monitoring: Lighthouse prompt set & eval harness handoff
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Ruiz <evan@medbridge.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quality monitoring: Lighthouse prompt set & eval harness handoff

Hi Evan —

Thanks for the sync yesterday. Per our conversation, I’m creating a small lighthouse prompt set and an integration checklist so your team can validate model behavior before we enable auto-rollout. Attached are the initial prompt set (CSV) and a short eval-harness checklist for the first run.

High-level ask from MedBridge: sanity-check clinical summarization prompts across diverse note types and set up regression alerts for key metrics (factuality, hallucination rate, and instruction-following).

Proposed next steps:
- Your team runs the eval harness against the CSV prompt set and shares failure snippets (ideally < 48 hours).
- We configure a canary rollout: 5% traffic / 24h stability window, regress if token-level hallucination > 2x baseline or F1 drops > 8%.
- If canary fails, automatic rollback to the previous pinned model; we’ll triage issues in a focused bug triage call.

Lauren and Tessa (cc’d) will lead the integration and monitoring setup from our side. Evan — would Thursday at 10am PT work to review initial harness output?

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: lighthouse_promptset_v1.csv (CSV prompt set, 120 rows)
Attachments: eval-harness-integration-checklist.pdf (8 pages)

From: Evan Ruiz <evan@medbridge.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quality monitoring: Lighthouse prompt set & eval harness handoff

Thanks Marcus —

Thursday 10am PT works. We’ll scope the run to three note types (discharge summary, progress note, referral) and return the raw failing outputs plus a short spreadsheet with example failure categories. Expect an initial run by Friday EOD.

A couple of clarifying Qs: 
1) Does "hallucination rate" map to the hallucination tag in the eval harness or do you want token-level divergence?
2) Can you drop the desired alerting thresholds into the checklist so our SRE knows the pager rules?

I’ll bring Sarah (clinical lead) to the call if we see significant edge cases.

—Evan
Evan Ruiz
Director, Customer Success — MedBridge

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Ruiz <evan@medbridge.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 Jun 2028 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quality monitoring: Lighthouse prompt set & eval harness handoff

Evan —

Quick answers inline: 
1) Use the hallucination tag from the harness for human-review signals; we’ll additionally compute token-level divergence for canary triggers (token-hallucination-rate).
2) I added the alert thresholds to the checklist under section 3 — paging rules and severity mapping. For the canary we recommend:
   - ticket (warning): hallucination tag rate > baseline * 1.4 or F1 drop > 5% (creates a CS ticket)
   - page (critical): hallucination tag rate > baseline * 2.0 OR F1 drop > 8% OR any clinical-accuracy regression on sentinel prompts

Operational notes: 
- We’ll onboard by creating an eval-run workspace in your account (drive link in the email) and share an ephemeral API key scoped to eval-only.
- Priyom will supply the canary/rollback matrix and a short script to push rollback signals to your deployment pipeline.

I’ll prep the 10am deck (5 slides) outlining the harness outputs you’ll get and the failure triage flow.

—Lauren

Attachments: canary-rollback-matrix.xlsx (matrix and automated webhook mapping)

From: Evan Ruiz <evan@medbridge.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 21 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quality monitoring: Lighthouse prompt set & eval harness handoff

On the call we walked the sample outputs and a few notes:
- Discharge summaries produced the most hallucination flags (7/30). Some were truncated references to meds.
- Progress notes had instruction-following issues (missed items in the checklist).

Action items we own:
- Share the raw CSV of failing examples (I’ll send by EOD).
- Fine-tune prompt templates for the progress-note family and re-run.

Request for Redwood: can you confirm the canary webhook format so our infra team can validate it against our staging webhook consumer? We’ll validate the rollback trigger locally before we flip to 5% traffic.

Thanks — Evan

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Ruiz <evan@medbridge.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 Jun 2028 09:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Canary webhook & rollback schema (short)

Evan / team —

Snippet of the webhook payload we’ll POST to your consumer on canary failure:

--- forwarded message ---
From: Redwood Inference Canary Service <canary@redwood.ai>
To: medbridge-canary@medbridge.ai
Subject: Canary Failure Alert — RDW-4739 (5% -> rollback)

payload: {
  "deal_id": "RDW-4739",
  "canary_id": "canary-20280622-01",
  "metric": "hallucination_token_rate",
  "value": "0.047",
  "baseline": "0.018",
  "threshold": "2.0",
  "action": "rollback",
  "rollback_model": "model-mri-v2.3"
}

We will sign the payload with the shared key and include an X-Redwood-Signature header. If you need HMAC vs. RSA, tell us.

We’ll also provide a test endpoint and a small python verifier in the drive folder so your infra can simulate both pass and fail signals.

—Priyom

From: Evan Ruiz <evan@medbridge.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 Jun 2028 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Canary webhook & rollback schema (short)

Perfect — thanks Priyom.

We validated the webhook schema against our staging consumer and the signed payload test worked. We also finished the failing CSV and uploaded it to the drive folder (link in HubSpot note).

Next steps:
- MedBridge will run one more harness pass after we update prompt templates (ETA Monday).
- Redwood to provision the eval-run workspace and schedule a triage call if the canary triggers rollback.

If both the harness pass and webhook smoke tests look good, we’ll go ahead with 5% canary starting Tuesday morning.

—Evan
